name: 06798 · Woodbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06798 (Woodbury) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 16 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06798 (Woodbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06798 (Woodbury) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
